name: producer-pipeline-flow
title: Pipeline Flow
description: The active wiring (clossys.pipeline-wiring/1: steps that exist, states from their latest run records) rendered by @xyflow/react inside a stock Card as a swimlane: lanes are the seat holders (the pipeline roster, plus Unassigned while any step has no holder), columns are the stages, grouped by round: one stock secondary Badge round header above each round's stage columns, and the stages as stock outline Badges under it; one components.flow.base-node per step invocation wrapped in the React Flow UI NodeStatusIndicator, a stock Badge carrying its run state, its header the stock shadcn Item; a seat in the URL highlights that lane with stock Item and Badge variants; the pinned smoothstep edge, stock Controls and MiniMap; selecting a step opens a read-only shadcn Sheet whose facts (stage, holder with kind, tier and file or derived source) are stock Field label + value pairs, with the run record it cites and each check's state.
author: Clossys
